_comment: The two states no file can prove, keyed <ledger>#<batch> for a ledger and notebook#<id> for a notebook: checked, skipped. Everything else the site shows is read off the files by npm run manifest. Only write "checked" if a person really has compared the batch with the photographs, sheet by sheet. "skipped" is for a batch judged to hold nothing to transcribe, which the absence of a file cannot distinguish from a batch nobody has reached. Nothing is claimed here yet: a batch that has a transcription shows as drafted, and that is observed rather than declared.
